question.text: Which of the following is the correct reporting hierarchy for PM financial-crime / suspicious-activity reporting?

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA: Principal Officer (designated) → FIU-IND directly. PMS website/exchange aren't reporting destinations. The Trap: Client → Compliance is an internal escalation path, not the regulatory report. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV, III-A, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain a separate mobile number/email for FIU reporting — keeps operational logs distinct from STR/CTR filings.
